answer: Random peer audit stops fake identities. Each agent posts a 60-credit bond locked for 20 epochs. Claims are split like light through a prism, so one forged part fails the check. Each epoch a beacon picks 10% for audit by 3 random peers, who check the agent's atlas of counterparties; a plume of matching accounts flags a cluster. Forging 1000 identities costs 60000 credits, while an honest agent pays 60 once and earns undiluted rewards.
